extraction_notes: The supplied PDF identifies LBSS138LT1G and S-LBSS138LT1G as LRC Power MOSFET variants; this extraction targets the exact MPN LBSS138LT1G and manufacturer LRC.
The part is an N-channel MOSFET. Electrical quantities are transcribed in SI units; resistance and capacitance values are positive quantities.

Typical transfer, on-region output, capacitance, and body-diode curves were digitized from the plotted traces on pages 3 and 4 and rounded to compact readings. No unplotted points were invented or interpolated.
The threshold-voltage typical column is blank in the electrical-characteristics table, so threshold_typ is null.
The table publishes typical and maximum capacitance values. The strict schema stores the typical Ciss, Coss, and Crss values, while the corresponding maxima are 50 pF, 25 pF, and 5.0 pF respectively.
The body-diode forward-voltage table row is not provided; body_diode is represented by a digitized 25 degC Figure 10 point at approximately 30 mA.
The first RDS(on) row specifies ID < 200 mA rather than an exact current; the current field uses 0.2 A as the printed upper-bound reference and preserves the strict inequality in conditions.
